Name: Content Patcher Editor
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod is an attempt to facilitate the process of creating and maintaining Content Patcher mods via a user-friendly in-game menu.


[b][size=5]Usage[/size][/b]

Open the menu using a hotkey combination (default [b]LeftShift + RightBracket[/b]) or by clicking the tree button in the bottom left of the Title Menu.

The main menu shows a list of installed Content Patcher packs.

You can add a new, empty Content Patcher pack by pressing the green plus button.

Clicking on a pack name opens the pack edit menu.


[b][size=5]Menu[/size][/b]

The edit menu has three tabs.

The [b]Manifest [/b]tab lets you edit most of the fields in the mod's manifest.json file.

The [b]Changes [/b]tab lets you edit and add Content Patcher changes. See the [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/blob/stable/ContentPatcher/docs/author-guide.md#actions]Content Patcher Action documentation[/url] for more info on each type and field.

The [b]Config[/b] tab lets you edit and add config variables. Se the [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/blob/stable/ContentPatcher/docs/author-guide/config.md]Content Patcher Config documentation[/url] for more info.


[b][size=5]Buttons[/size][/b]

There is a [b]Back[/b] button in the top left to return to the packs list.

There are [b]Add[/b] buttons in the bottom right on the [b]Changes[/b] and [b]Config[/b] tabs to add new changes and config variables.

There are [b]Zip, Reload[/b], and [b]Folder[/b] buttons on the left side of the bottom bar to create a zip file of the pack in the Mods folder, reload the pack (causing Content Patcher to recognize your changes immediately), and open the pack's file folder in explorer.

There are [b]Save[/b] and [b]Revert[/b] buttons that appear in the middle of the bottom bar when a content pack has been changed. [b]Revert[/b] erases all unsaved changes.


[b][size=5]Config[/size][/b]

You can change the hotkey combination to open the menu in the config.

By default, backup files are created when you save a changed content pack. You can turn this off in the config.

You can change the config by editing the config file or using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].


[b][size=5]Limitations[/size][/b]

The [b]Reload[/b] button uses Content Patcher's [b]patch reload[/b] command, which may have limitations on what can be reloaded (config, tokens, etc.) in-game.

In the [b]Manifest [/b]tab, [b]Dependencies[/b] can't yet be edited using the menu.

In the [b]Changes[/b] tab, for [b]EditData[/b] type, only [b]Entries [/b]has been implemented. For [b]EditMap[/b] type, [b]TextOperations[/b] hasn't been implemented.

For [b]EditData[/b],  only [b]Entries [/b]that have string values are editable at the moment - other values will appear as blanks but should be preserved even if you edit the key and save the mod.

The mod uses the version of Content Patcher installed on your machine when creating a new [b]Format[/b] field.

This mod is new and hasn't been rigorously tested. Please report any bugs or issues.


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url].

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].
